documents.subject: Spring offsite - dates
documents.body:
Chris,

Can we lock in the week of April 24 for the spring offsite? Lina is holding rooms at the Elora Mill for two nights. Please send me the finance agenda items by Friday so I can circulate a draft.

Thanks,
Robert

documents.subject: Bayview Towns - window samples
documents.body:
Hi Robert,

The two window suppliers for the Bayview townhomes dropped off samples at the office this afternoon. Loewen is about 8% more expensive but can deliver in June; the other supplier cannot commit before September. I recommend we go with Loewen and I will ask for a revised quote with the triple-glazed option.

David
